# rubric-gate

Report-only composite action at `tuannx/maven/.github/actions/rubric-gate`. Writes `verdict.json`. Does not fail the step on `AUTO_FIX` or `ESCALATE`. Personal fork only. Do not open pull requests on apache/maven. Do not create tags or releases. `v0` is not a git tag.

Skill: `docs/agents/rubric-gate.md`. Schema: `schema.json` (`schema_version` 2). Thresholds: ADR-0010. Structural checks: ADR-0011 and `docs/adr/boundaries.yml`.

## Inputs

| name | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| command | merge | `plan`, `score`, `merge`, or `all` |
| scorer | empty | `affected-build`, `japicmp`, `spotless`, `comment-density`, `bench-delta` |
| base | empty | three-dot diff ref, for example `origin/master` |
| out | `rubric-gate-results` | scorer JSON and `verdict.json` |
| loop | `0` | `AUTO_FIX` attempts already consumed. `2` escalates |
| llm-hook | `false` | when true, run `llm-hook-command` and store notes. Scores stay put |
| llm-hook-command | empty | argv. Stdin is dimension JSON. Stdout is `{"notes":["..."]}` |
| unit-test-rc | `0` | non-zero fails hard rule `gate-unit-tests` |

## Outputs

| name | meaning |
|---|---|
| needs_maven | `true` when `plan` or `score` needs Maven installed first |
| verdict | set by `merge` and `all` |
| verdict-path | workspace path of `verdict.json` |

## Permissions

| scope | when |
|---|---|
| contents: read | checkout. Enough for `plan`, `score`, and `merge` |
| actions: write | job that runs `actions/upload-artifact`. Name the step in the job comment |
| actions: read | bench-delta lists `build-speedup-bench` runs for `RUBRIC_BENCH_SHA` when the bench path filter matches. ADR-0012 |

`contents: write` is not used. `pull-requests: write` is not used.

## Hook

Disabled by default. v0 ignores any scores the hook prints. ADR-0006.
